method: Complete generated Radio21/23/24/25 transcripts read; targeted Radio24/25 repairs read; seven primary launch outcomes and expanded pitches read in normal browser.
boundary: No full manual listening, audit, completed refund or exhaustive founder archive claimed. Mutable raise pitches have no established revision dates.

projects.name: GameByts
projects.people: Mihai Chitafes (founder/CEO); Tudor Sandru (CTO); Alexandru Neagoe (engineering)
projects.note: Archived pitch separates GameByts reported $13K revenue and $150K marketplace volume from the team’s previous skins marketplace, reported at $10M revenue and $2M profit. Neither set is independently audited. Radio25 describes planned reward and distribution economics; it does not establish sustainable rewards.
projects.gaps: Personal founder writing, financial corroboration and refund execution remain open.

projects.name: Aeonian
projects.people: Juntdoe (@juntdoe), founder and lead developer; Radio25 guest describes a business-development role, not founder status
projects.note: Current archived pitch claims a live mainnet beta and names Juntdoe as founder. Radio25 describes devnet trading and a prospective social layer. The mutable pitch has no revision date, so it does not establish when the transition occurred. Retention, revenue distribution and grants are issuer claims.
projects.gaps: Founder X archive, dated mainnet transition, public metrics, audit and refund execution remain open.

projects.name: Digg
projects.people: Not established; @karthikdigg is a contact in the pitch, not sufficient proof of founder title
projects.note: Archived pitch describes opt-in coding-session datasets, contributor rewards and planned AI-lab pilots. Radio23’s earlier $60K target differs from this $80K attempt. Interest and introductions are not paying customers; advertised AI-stock rewards do not establish delivered securities or returns.
projects.gaps: Founder identity, personal archive, privacy implementation, customers and refund execution remain open.

projects.name: Ryvo Network
projects.people: Luka Matcharadze, solo founder named in the pitch
projects.note: Archived pitch describes agent payment channels and a provider gateway. It explicitly says no mainnet contracts yet, despite a roadmap for mainnet beta. Audit, entity incorporation and licensing counsel remain prospective. Brand/IP transfer includes a stated reversion to the founding team on dissolution; no completed transfer is inferred.
projects.gaps: Founder personal archive, deployment and audit evidence, entity/IP execution and refunds remain open.

projects.name: HIIE, from Arthur Labs
projects.people: W LR (founder/CEO in pitch; Radio21 speaker self-identifies as Watson); Marko Ruble named as founding member; JE and GT retain published initials
projects.note: Pitch describes invention workflows, CAD, automation and proposed token/legal-formation services. Radio21 distinguishes intended HIIE project IP from the separate Arthur Labs agency. Federal compute support is sought, not shown awarded. Forecast revenue, old-token migration and DAO/IP arrangements remain plans.
projects.gaps: Arthur Labs Medium archive, precise entity scope, previous-token migration, founder archives and refund execution remain open.

projects.name: SuperPumped
projects.people: No named founder established from reviewed pitch; Radio23 guest attribution remains limited
projects.note: Pitch describes private-beta leveraged prediction markets, isolated vaults and research tooling. Reported 90.04% selective historical accuracy is not live profitability or guaranteed performance. Radio23 discusses planned audits, liquidity and privacy features; implementation and security remain unverified.
projects.gaps: Founder identity and archives, complete audit, live deployment and refund execution remain open.

projects.name: Degen Terminal
projects.people: Kelvin Alkorogie, founder named in Team section
projects.note: Pitch describes a multichain trading terminal and planned unified DGNT token. It claims 2,000+ ecosystem signups; integrations and safety checks are issuer claims. The Q4 launch and old-token distribution roadmap is not proof of execution and is not treated as a second raise.
projects.gaps: Kelvin’s personal archive, previous-token distribution, platform usage, safety implementation and refund execution remain open.
